name: Lakeside Metaverse

## Welcome to Lakeside Metaverse

**Trauma touches nearly everyone — yet most of us struggle to recognize or understand it in ourselves and others.** Lakeside Metaverse, the immersive learning platform of LakeCloud.ai, brings it into perspective through 3D stories, expert presentations, and powerful hands-on interactives.

Start with our **free LakeCloud - Intro to Trauma course** to build the foundation.

### Step Into Four Lives
